product_metadata.title: TEMPUR-Up Foundation, Twin XL/Split King (Purchase 2 Foundations to Complete a King Set)
features: Provides the perfect upgrade from a flat foundation
Raise the head up to 55 degrees for virtually unlimited positions for reading, working on your laptop or watching TV
Control your movement with a simple-to-use wired remote with a single button to "return-to-flat" position
Designed as the perfect match and engineered to enhance the performance of your new mattress
Twin XL measures 79" L x 37.5" W and weighs 119 pounds

Getting Acquainted to your new product: Your new mattress may feel more firm than expected. Please give the mattress time to “break-in.” You may also notice a “new product smell” at first. As with most new purchases, this is normal and will dissipate in a couple weeks.
description: Power your sleep with the TEMPUR-Up Foundation. The TEMPUR-Up Foundation is the perfect upgrade from a flat foundation.Raise the head up to 55 degrees and enjoy virtually infinite number of positions, for reading, working on your laptop, or watching TV. Control your movement using the simple-to-use wired remote. Designed as the perfect match and engineered to enhance the performance of your new mattress. The TEMPUR-Up is operated with a easy-to-use wired remote for head-up and head-down adjustments and with a single button to "return to flat" position. The TEMPUR-Up fits the standard bed frame or can be paired with purchased legs in 9-inch, 6.5-inch or 4.5-inch heights. The TEMPUR-Up Foundation can lift up to 600 pounds and the Twin XL measures 79" L x 37.5" W and weights 119 pounds. Backed by a 15-year limited warranty, the TEMPUR-Up provides you with the perfect upgrade from a flat foundation.
